text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: It's time for the second battle of our Triple Tiara tour—the Japanese Oaks. As usual, Fine Motion seems entirely unfazed by the race ahead.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: The Umamusume who was struggling back at the Oka Sho notes that Fine Motion doesn't get nervous because she always has another path ahead of her even if she loses.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Fine Motion doesn't deny it. Free from anxiety, she enjoys herself no matter which race she runs in. That said, she understands how important this race is.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: On top of that, her time here is limited… And that's precisely why she won't hold anything back, and why she wants the competition to run their best too.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Fine Motion's candid feelings remind the other Umamusume to run her own way. And so, the race begins…
